assertions.assertion: The service is a cardiac event monitoring study.
The patient has recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness.
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The diagnosis code for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation is I48.0.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction.
The diagnosis codes for history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction are Z86.73 and G45.9.
The study was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of transient cerebral ischemic events.
The study was ordered to guide anticoagulation management.
The service billed under CPT 93271 is medically necessary.
